interaction: Scroll down through a generated skin cross-section (sticky specimen with a reticle on desktop, per-layer slices on phones) while a depth gauge reads out micrometres and the layer; treatments appear at the depth they work. A four-question routine builder (skin type, main concern, sensitivity, SPF habit) returns AM and PM steps using generic product types only, with general-information notes.
notes: The cross-section is diagrammatic and not to scale (epidermis enlarged); depth figures are typical values for facial skin.
